concept: The Stitched Map: Kala Ghoda drawn as embroidery on woven cloth. A needle leads the thread along the real streets, the cafe is a button, facts hang from strings on tags, prices are embroidered numerals. No music, Sana's voice over cloth, scissors and ceramic foley.

dimensions.palette: deep indigo ground, chalk cool white, madder rose thread, mint accent
dimensions.fonts: Fraunces serif headlines (editorial, italic accents) + DM Mono tiny labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: route-line draw: one thread stitched along the real streets, a needle leading it
dimensions.transition: match cut on shape: button becomes the plate, stitch line becomes the table edge
dimensions.camera: flat top-down on cloth with slow drift and thread-length parallax
dimensions.sound: cloth and ceramic foley with Sana narration, no music
dimensions.ending: thread ties off in a knot and the scissors snip

experiment.hypothesis: Drawing real streets as running stitches makes the map feel crafted and ties the film to Chorus's textile identity without using any photos
